pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with moderately smooth edge gradients. The dark pigmentation is dominant, with some patches showing slightly lighter interior regions relative to the darker, crisp perimeters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness with clear multi-path junction nodes across the lateral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous 1D silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the upper neck, indicating short, dense mane hair.

other_distinctive_markers: A small bird (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge near the base of the neck. A second organism with black and white vertical striping (Equus quagga) is partially visible in the lower foreground.
